title: WHAT IF YOU HID IN A LIBRARY?

outline.1: Day 0-3. Lock in, base tour (stone walls, 1 door, high windows), rule of 3s, taps die, rain harvesting math, first flush, boil 1 min. Storm noise turns 300 heads; wooden back door cracks. CHOICE: carry water to the stone basement OR keep collecting on the roof.
outline.2: Result of vote. Hold the back door: interleaved books (friction - two interleaved phone books took two military vehicles to pull apart). Night: an SOS light (... --- ...) blinks from the school across the street. CHOICE: answer the light OR stay dark.
outline.3: Rosa (13) alone in the school kitchen with food. Light-signal talk. Plan to cross 30 m of street: noise decoy. CHOICE: bring Rosa over OR send her supplies on a line.
outline.4: Two people now: food math halves, sleep in shifts, cold nights - paper/books as insulation, body heat. Twist: someone else is reading the signals. CHOICE.
outline.5: Rosa gets a fever - bite check rule, dehydration/fever facts, oral rehydration (sugar + salt in water). CHOICE.
outline.6: Fire risk: a building full of paper (paper ignites around 450 F). Raiders or the horde force a decision. CHOICE.
outline.7: Finale: escape plan using every lesson (water, signals, decoys) - final ending.

history.question: Carry all your water down to the stone basement, OR stay on the roof and keep collecting while the storm lasts
